prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Miami after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Miami for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
Here are several specific Miami-area personal-injury firms you should call and why each is worth contacting. If you tell me your zip code or the seriousness of your injuries I can narrow this list to firms closest to you or that specialize in catastrophic cases.

1) Morgan & Morgan (Miami office)
- Why: One of the largest plaintiff firms in the country with a Miami office and lots of resources (investigators, expert witnesses). Good if you want a firm that can handle complex insurance fights and large cases. Spanish-speaking staff available.

2) Colson Hicks Eidson
- Why: Florida plaintiff trial firm with experience in car crashes and wrongful-death cases. Known for handling serious injury claims and taking cases to trial when appropriate.

3) Steinger, Greene & Feiner
- Why: Florida-based firm that focuses on car-accident and personal-injury claims. They handle many auto cases statewide and can move quickly to investigate wrecks and medical issues.

4) Anidjar & Levine
- Why: Florida personal-injury firm with a presence in South Florida that handles auto accidents and catastrophic injury claims; they do contingency-fee work and offer free consultations.

5) Kanner & Pintaluga (serving South Florida)
- Why: Regional plaintiffs’ firm experienced with serious personal-injury and wrongful-death claims in South Florida courts; good trial experience for higher-value or complex cases.

What to ask each firm when you call
- Do you handle car-accident cases in Miami? (Yes → ask how many last year.)
- Who will handle my case (attorney name vs. paralegal)?
- What is your contingency fee and are there any upfront costs?
- Do you have experience with my specific injuries (e.g., whiplash, fractures, spinal)?
- Will you take the case to trial if necessary?
- How quickly can you start investigating (police report, witnesses, vehicle inspection)?
- Do you offer Spanish-language services if needed?

What to have ready for the call
- Date/location of the crash, police report number (if available)
- Photos of vehicles/injuries
- Insurance info (your policy and the other driver’s)
- Names/contacts of witnesses
- Brief summary of medical treatment so far

How to choose among calls
- Prefer firms that will meet (or visit you) in person or at the hospital if needed
- Look for trial experience if injuries are severe
- Check recent client reviews and the Florida Bar status of the attorney (no disciplinary actions)
- Compare communication style and responsiveness during the free consult

If you want, tell me:
- your zip code (so I can suggest firms nearest you),
- how badly you were hurt,
- whether you need a Spanish-speaking attorney,
and I’ll tailor the list and suggest the top 2 to call first.
